title: Ilyas Shah vs Delhi Sultanate Conflict
subtitle: Early sovereignty contests after Bengal unification.
summary: After unification, Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah faced military pressure from the Delhi Sultanate, and the resulting conflict helped define the practical boundaries of Bengal sultanate sovereignty.
heroTagline: Early sovereignty contests after Bengal unification.
whyItMatters: It established Bengal as a durable regional power with its own political center despite repeated imperial contestation.
